new.brief: Creates a new constraint representing a relation between a layout attribute on a source and a layout attribute on a target.
new.md:
Creates a new constraint representing a relation between a layout
attribute on a source and a layout attribute on a target.

new_constant.brief: Creates a new constraint representing a relation between a layout attribute on a target and a constant value.
new_constant.md:
Creates a new constraint representing a relation between a layout
attribute on a target and a constant value.

doc.brief: Describes a constraint between attributes of two widgets, expressed as a linear equation.
doc.md:
Describes a constraint between attributes of two widgets,
 expressed as a linear equation.

The typical equation for a constraint is:

```
  target.target_attr = source.source_attr × multiplier + constant
```

Each `GtkConstraint` is part of a system that will be solved by a
[`ConstraintLayout`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintLayout) in order to allocate and position each
child widget or guide.

The source and target, as well as their attributes, of a `GtkConstraint`
instance are immutable after creation.

get_constant.brief: Retrieves the constant factor added to the source attributes' value.
get_constant.md: Retrieves the constant factor added to the source attributes' value.

get_multiplier.brief: Retrieves the multiplication factor applied to the source attribute's value.
get_multiplier.md:
Retrieves the multiplication factor applied to the source
attribute's value.

get_relation.brief: The order relation between the terms of the constraint.
get_relation.md: The order relation between the terms of the constraint.

get_source.brief: Retrieves the [`ConstraintTarget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintTarget) used as the source for the constraint.
get_source.md:
Retrieves the [`ConstraintTarget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintTarget) used as the source for the
constraint.

If the source is set to `NULL` at creation, the constraint will use
the widget using the [`ConstraintLayout`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintLayout) as the source.

get_source_attribute.brief: Retrieves the attribute of the source to be read by the constraint.
get_source_attribute.md: Retrieves the attribute of the source to be read by the constraint.

get_strength.brief: Retrieves the strength of the constraint.
get_strength.md: Retrieves the strength of the constraint.

get_target.brief: Retrieves the [`ConstraintTarget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintTarget) used as the target for the constraint.
get_target.md:
Retrieves the [`ConstraintTarget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintTarget) used as the target for
the constraint.

If the targe is set to `NULL` at creation, the constraint will use
the widget using the [`ConstraintLayout`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintLayout) as the target.

get_target_attribute.brief: Retrieves the attribute of the target to be set by the constraint.
get_target_attribute.md: Retrieves the attribute of the target to be set by the constraint.

is_attached.brief: Checks whether the constraint is attached to a [`ConstraintLayout`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintLayout), and it is contributing to the layout.
is_attached.md:
Checks whether the constraint is attached to a [`ConstraintLayout`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintLayout),
and it is contributing to the layout.

is_constant.brief: Checks whether the constraint describes a relation between an attribute on the [`Constraint:target`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:target) and a constant value.
is_constant.md:
Checks whether the constraint describes a relation between an attribute
on the [`Constraint:target`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:target) and a constant value.

is_required.brief: Checks whether the constraint is a required relation for solving the constraint layout.
is_required.md:
Checks whether the constraint is a required relation for solving the
constraint layout.

constant.brief: The constant value to be added to the [`Constraint:source-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source-attribute).
constant.md: The constant value to be added to the [`Constraint:source-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source-attribute).

multiplier.brief: The multiplication factor to be applied to the [`Constraint:source-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source-attribute).
multiplier.md:
The multiplication factor to be applied to
the [`Constraint:source-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source-attribute).

relation.brief: The order relation between the terms of the constraint.
relation.md: The order relation between the terms of the constraint.

source.md:
The source of the constraint.

The constraint will set the [`Constraint:target-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:target-attribute)
property of the target using the [`Constraint:source-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source-attribute)
property of the source.

source-attribute.brief: The attribute of the [`Constraint:source`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source) read by the constraint.
source-attribute.md:
The attribute of the [`Constraint:source`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source) read by the
constraint.

strength.md:
The strength of the constraint.

The strength can be expressed either using one of the symbolic values
of the [`ConstraintStrength`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstraintStrength) enumeration, or any positive integer
value.

target.md:
The target of the constraint.

The constraint will set the [`Constraint:target-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:target-attribute)
property of the target using the [`Constraint:source-attribute`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:source-attribute)
property of the source widget.

target-attribute.brief: The attribute of the [`Constraint:target`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:target) set by the constraint.
target-attribute.md: The attribute of the [`Constraint:target`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Constraint#property:target) set by the constraint.
